name: Continued Threat
summary: Katar is pleased that your hatred of the fish men is growing alongside Katar's own, and sends you to hunt further fish men on the beach in the Swamp of Sorrows.

sections.title: More Along the Beach
sections.body: Katar tells you to find more of the fish men along the beach, and to return once you have had enough of fighting. Marsh inkspewers, marsh flesheaters and marsh oracles are the ones wanted. Katar will take no pleasure until the sea and every one of her children is silenced, least of all the repulsive fish men.

faq.answer: Katar, in the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: What creatures need to be hunted?
faq.answer: Katar wants marsh inkspewers, marsh flesheaters and marsh oracles along the beach.

faq.q: Why does Katar want the murlocs culled?
faq.answer: Katar will take no pleasure until the sea and her brood are silenced, the fish men most of all.
It follows the previous Threat From the Sea, after which Tok'Kar offered you a weapon.
